note: Hero colossi (render/colossi.js). kind arch leans across the road, crossing crossUpM above it at s; kind tower stands beside. Heights in metres; the fitter only ever raises an arch or steps a tower out. tint is each body colour (chess pieces never warm: no red, orange, gold, tan or pink); seam is kept for a later accent and is not drawn. Polish 3 review: the king is an upright tower right of the start straight (laid over the road it showed its underside, tilted toward the camera it read as a bare shaft), so its gold crown reads against the sky, the bishop arch is gone (it read as a tentacle), the watch shows its face, the knight is a tower whose head rises beside the road at eye height (knight 1150 to 1110 for the spiral gate at f 0.86), the queen crown sits lower, rook 1250 to 1268 (billboard at f 0.92). Polish 6 (the stacked course): every body refitted to a new s and side by a search over the lap (same height, lean, yaw, tint and look); the fitter then raises the watch and steps the queen, cabinet and rook out from the decks.
